story.headline: NIFTY 25,400 is in an uptrend (+9.1% vs its 50-day average, +5.9% vs its 200-day), trending (ADX 37), momentum overbought (RSI 81), India VIX 17.6 (higher than on 81% of the past year's sessions).

lines.text: RSI(14) above 70: day 4. 74 past spells since 2007 lasted a median 4 sessions; 75% had ended by 8. Of spells that reached day 4, 59% lasted 3 more sessions and 41% 5 more. Next 10 sessions: up 57% of the time vs 57% normally, average +0.6% vs +0.4%. No reliable direction. Moves were smaller: 2.2% vs 2.9% normally.

Stochastic above 80: day 7. 183 past spells since 2007 lasted a median 7 sessions; 75% had ended by 12. Of spells that reached day 7, 65% lasted 3 more sessions and 48% 5 more. Next 10 sessions: up 54% of the time vs 57% normally, average +0.3% vs +0.4%. No reliable direction.

Above the upper Bollinger band: day 7. 100 past spells since 2007 lasted a median 2 sessions; 75% had ended by 3. Only 5% of past spells got this old. Of spells that reached day 7, 20% lasted 3 more sessions and 0% 5 more. Next 10 sessions: up 54% of the time vs 57% normally, average +0.4% vs +0.4%. No reliable direction. Moves were smaller: 2.4% vs 2.9% normally.

5%+ above the 50-day average: day 4. 63 past spells since 2007 lasted a median 4 sessions; 75% had ended by 16. Of spells that reached day 4, 70% lasted 3 more sessions and 60% 5 more. Next 10 sessions: up 57% of the time vs 57% normally, average +0.2% vs +0.4%. No reliable direction.

RSI above 70 in an uptrend: day 4. 68 past spells since 2007 lasted a median 4 sessions; 75% had ended by 10. Of spells that reached day 4, 59% lasted 3 more sessions and 44% 5 more. Next 10 sessions: up 55% of the time vs 57% normally, average +0.3% vs +0.4%. No reliable direction. Moves were smaller: 1.9% vs 2.9% normally.

Strong uptrend (ADX > 25, +DI on top): day 7. 54 past spells since 2007 lasted a median 12 sessions; 75% had ended by 28. Of spells that reached day 7, 92% lasted 3 more sessions and 85% 5 more. Next 10 sessions: up 55% of the time vs 57% normally, average +0.7% vs +0.4%. No reliable direction.

MACD above its signal line: day 20. 163 past spells since 2007 lasted a median 12 sessions; 75% had ended by 20. Of spells that reached day 20, 85% lasted 3 more sessions and 63% 5 more. Next 10 sessions: up 59% of the time vs 57% normally, average +0.6% vs +0.4%. No reliable direction.

India VIX in the top 20% of its year: day 3. 62 past spells since 2007 lasted a median 7 sessions; 75% had ended by 26. Of spells that reached day 3, 72% lasted 3 more sessions and 64% 5 more. Next 10 sessions: up 43% of the time vs 57% normally, average -0.9% vs +0.4%. A reliable downward lean (both halves agree, |t| >= 2).

VIX in its top 20% while NIFTY rallies in an uptrend: day 3. 42 past spells since 2007 lasted a median 4 sessions; 75% had ended by 10. Of spells that reached day 3, 67% lasted 3 more sessions and 58% 5 more. Next 10 sessions: up 56% of the time vs 57% normally, average +0.5% vs +0.4%. No reliable direction.

NIFTY up and VIX up over 5 sessions: day 3. 100 past spells since 2007 lasted a median 2 sessions; 75% had ended by 4. Of spells that reached day 3, 25% lasted 3 more sessions and 19% 5 more. Next 10 sessions: up 61% of the time vs 57% normally, average +0.6% vs +0.4%. No reliable direction.

bottom: Direction: India VIX in the top 20% of its year has a reliable record - over the next 10 sessions NIFTY rose 43% of the time vs 57% normally, in both halves of the history. But the narrower case that matches today - VIX in its top 20% while NIFTY rallies in an uptrend - does not carry it: up 56% vs 57% over 34 spells (no edge). Treat the warning as unconfirmed.

Range: RSI(14) above 70, Above the upper Bollinger band, RSI above 70 in an uptrend - moves afterwards were smaller than normal, in both halves of the history. That favours selling premium over buying it.
picture: Direction: none of today's readings has called direction reliably. Take the base rate: NIFTY ended higher by 29-Dec-2026 in 64% of all past 34-session stretches, and 61% from days like today. The one historically reliable warning on now (India VIX in the top 20% of its year) is not confirmed by the narrower case that matches today.

This week (17-Nov-2026, 4 sessions): likely settle 25,139 to 25,738; 8 in 10 between 24,720 and 25,972. Puts below 24,700 and calls above 26,000 expired worthless in about 9 of 10 similar cases on each side (in 639 walk-forward tests this band held 80% of the time, against the 80% it claims).

Next week = this month (23-Nov-2026, 8 sessions): likely settle 25,154 to 26,026; 8 in 10 between 24,496 and 26,277. Puts below 24,450 and calls above 26,300 expired worthless in about 9 of 10 similar cases on each side (in 638 walk-forward tests this band held 79% of the time, against the 80% it claims).

Weekly (01-Dec-2026, 14 sessions): likely settle 25,176 to 26,163; 8 in 10 between 24,530 and 26,634. Puts below 24,500 and calls above 26,650 expired worthless in about 9 of 10 similar cases on each side (in 637 walk-forward tests this band held 79% of the time, against the 80% it claims).

Weekly (08-Dec-2026, 19 sessions): likely settle 25,053 to 26,310; 8 in 10 between 24,453 and 26,895. Puts below 24,450 and calls above 26,900 expired worthless in about 9 of 10 similar cases on each side (in 636 walk-forward tests this band held 78% of the time, against the 80% it claims).

Next month (29-Dec-2026, 34 sessions): likely settle 24,762 to 26,709; 8 in 10 between 23,920 and 27,858. Puts below 23,900 and calls above 27,900 expired worthless in about 9 of 10 similar cases on each side (in 633 walk-forward tests this band held 76% of the time, against the 80% it claims).

What would change this: the overbought spell (day 4) has a median life of 4 sessions. While it lasts, moves have been smaller than normal; once RSI drops back under 70 that cushion is gone, so re-check the ranges then.
Also watch India VIX: it is in the top fifth of its year. If NIFTY turns down while VIX stays high, the case moves from 'hedged rally' to 'fear in a falling market', which has had a weaker record.
